<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916418_theRebbe_902" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916418_theRebbe_902__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the seventh rectification is called "And Truth" because its root is in the unchanging nature of G-d.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one could say,</t>
    <t s="1">that this that the seventh rectification is called "And Truth"</t>
    <t s="2">(for the matter of truth is that which does not change)</t>
    <t s="3">is also because of its root,</t>
    <t s="4">for the level from which the drawing down of the seventh rectification comes is "I am G-d, I have not changed."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the highest level is drawn down to the lowest place, and that the true unchanging nature of G-d's Essence is drawn down primarily to the lower realm.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">d)</t>
    <t s="1">And now, according to what is known,</t>
    <t s="2">that whatever is highest of the highest is drawn down to the lowest of the lowest,</t>
    <t s="3">it is understood</t>
    <t s="4">that the seventh rectification,</t>
    <t s="5">the rectification of "And Truth,"</t>
    <t s="6">is drawn down primarily to the lower realm.</t>
    <t s="7">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="8">that the true essence of the matter of "I am G-d, I have not changed" is in His Essence and Being, whose existence</t>
    <t s="9">is from His own Essence and is not caused by any cause that preceded Him, G-d forbid.</t>
    <t s="10">For in the revelations,</t>
    <t s="11">which are preceded by a cause and a reason,</t>
    <t s="12">one cannot say the true essence of the matter of "I have not changed,"</t>
    <t s="13">for this very thing—that they are preceded by a cause and a reason—</t>
    <t s="14">is itself a change,</t>
    <t s="15">for there is a change between before it was drawn from the cause and reason,</t>
    <t s="16">and at the time it is drawn from the cause and reason,</t>
    <t s="17">and after it is drawn from the cause and reason.</t>
    <t s="18">But regarding His Essence and Being, which is not caused by any cause that preceded Him, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="19">there is no change in Him, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="20">[and this is] the true essence of the matter of "I am G-d, I have not changed."</t>
    <t s="21">And this matter is drawn down primarily to the lower realm,</t>
    <t s="22">and as explained by the Mitteler Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="23">that this that the lower entity feels that its existence is from His Essence,</t>
    <t s="24">and in its feeling no cause or reason preceded it,</t>
    <t s="25">is because its root is from His Essence and Being, whose existence is from His own Essence and is not caused by any cause that preceded Him, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="26">for the true existence of the existence of the created being is true being.</t>
    <t s="27">And as is explained at length in the maamar "Mi Chamochah" of the Rebbe Maharash.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the maamar "Mi Chamochah" was one of the Rebbe Maharash's fixed discourses, repeated every few years.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">[For,</t>
    <t s="1">as revealed by my father-in-law, the Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="2">— each of the Rebbes had fixed discourses which they would repeat publicly once every two or three years,</t>
    <t s="3">and one of these discourses of the Rebbe Maharash was the maamar "Mi Chamochah"],</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
